summary: The channel-keyed elastic regeneration sum sum_q Omega_q[x] * M_q(vr,vx,x): each named channel contributes its one-dimensional frequency profile multiplied into its three-dimensional regenerated distribution.

identity.relation: Beta_EL = sum over channels q of Omega_q[x] * M_q[vr,vx,x]
identity.direction: named channel frequency profiles plus regenerated distributions -> one aggregated source
identity.definition: The frequency and distribution key sets must match exactly; each term multiplies the (nx,) profile into the last axis; the saved dict iteration order defines the float summation order
identity.model: the saved formal implementation's channel aggregation
identity.geometry: two velocity dimensions over one spatial axis, one term per declared channel
identity.coordinates: frequencies in s^-1; distributions in the source's discrete units
identity.boundary: matching nonempty key sets; finite nonnegative (nx,) frequencies; finite nonnegative (nvr,nvx,nx) distributions with a matching spatial axis
assumptions: Channel keys are caller-declared identifiers (e.g. species-pair names); the asset does not interpret them.
Distributions and frequencies are expected nonnegative by physics and enforced so, as saved.

Declared r60 pre-review tightening: the saved arm does not gate its output for finiteness, so extreme-but-valid inputs can overflow to non-finite results; this asset fail-closes on a non-finite result, per the exact document's finite-output contract. The saved-arm divergence is pinned by a bounded regression test.

inputs.name: frequencies_s_inv
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; keys must match the distribution mapping exactly.

inputs.name: regenerated_distributions
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; each spatial axis must match its frequency profile.

outputs.name: regeneration_source
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; the saved-order channel sum.

preconditions: Matching nonempty channel key sets with aligned finite nonnegative fields.
supported: Elastic regeneration aggregation over caller-declared species-pair channels.
excluded: Mismatched key sets; empty channel sets; negative or non-finite fields; spatial-axis mismatches.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when the key sets do not match, no channel is present, or any field violates the finiteness, nonnegativity, or alignment contract.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError when the evaluation produces a non-finite result where the contract demands finiteness; no fallback is selected.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no result.
